product_overview: Plataforma comunitaria de ofertas y descuentos donde usuarios comparten y descubren promociones reales; enfocada en transparencia, economía colaborativa y contenido generado por la comunidad hispanohablante.
core_goals: Construir la comunidad de ofertas más grande de habla hispana con contenido generado por usuarios reales.
Facilitar el descubrimiento rápido de promociones verificables y relevantes mediante feed, búsqueda y filtros.
Permitir a usuarios publicar, votar y comentar ofertas, incentivando participación a través de gamificación.
Proveer herramientas de moderación y administración para mantener calidad y evitar abuso.

features.name: Home Feed
features.description: Página principal con feed de ofertas, filtros por pestañas (Para ti, Más hot, Tendencias) y sidebar con ofertas destacadas.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See deals feed with cards and filters -> Click deal card -> Navigate to /oferta/[id] -> See deal details
Navigate to / -> Network error loading feed -> See error state with Retry button -> Click Retry -> See deals feed or persistent error message

features.name: Authentication (Login & Register)
features.description: Registro y acceso de usuarios usando Supabase Auth para acceder a funciones restringidas (publicar, votar, perfil).
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/register -> Fill email and password -> Click Login/Register -> Receive confirmation email (if applicable) -> Click verification link in email -> Redirect to /perfil -> See user profile and welcome state
Navigate to /auth/login -> Fill email and password with incorrect credentials -> Click Login/Register -> See error message 'Invalid credentials' and stay on /auth/login
Navigate to /auth/register -> Fill email already in use -> Click Login/Register -> See validation error 'Email already registered'

features.name: Publish Offer (Publicar Oferta)
features.description: Formulario para que usuarios autenticados publiquen ofertas, cupones o discusiones con carga de imágenes y preview en tiempo real.
user_flows: Navigate to /publicar -> Fill deal form (title, price, description, link) -> Upload image -> See Preview in Time Real -> Click Submit deal -> See success confirmation and eventual appearance in feed after moderation
Navigate to /publicar (unauthenticated) -> See redirect to /auth/login -> Complete authentication -> Redirect back to /publicar
Navigate to /publicar -> Fill deal form missing title -> Upload image -> Click Submit deal -> See validation error 'Title is required' and remain on /publicar

features.name: Offer Detail (Detalle de Oferta) — View, Vote, Comment, Save
features.description: Página de detalle de oferta con información completa, sistema de votos hot/cold, sección de comentarios y enlace a tienda.
user_flows: Navigate to /oferta/[id] -> See information main (images, title, prices, author) -> Click Hot vote -> See vote counter increment and temperature update -> Add comment by filling text -> Click submit comment -> See comment listed in comments section
Navigate to /oferta/[id] (unauthenticated) -> Click Hot vote -> Redirect to /auth/login -> After login redirect back to /oferta/[id] -> See vote persisted or prompt to retry
Navigate to /oferta/[id] -> Fill comment field with empty content -> Click submit comment -> See validation error 'Comment cannot be empty' and remain in comment input

features.name: Search & Exploration
features.description: Búsqueda predictiva y filtros avanzados para encontrar ofertas por categoría, precio, tienda y relevancia.
user_flows: Navigate to /search -> Fill search bar -> See predictive suggestions while typing -> Select suggestion -> See filtered results list
Navigate to /search -> Fill search bar with uncommon query -> Click search -> See 'no results' state with suggestions to refine filters

features.name: Profile (Perfil de Usuario)
features.description: Panel de usuario autenticado con estadísticas, pestañas de contenido (Ofertas publicadas, Comentarios, Guardados) y ajustes de cuenta.
user_flows: Navigate to /perfil (authenticated) -> See statistics (points, level, offers published) -> Click 'Ofertas publicadas' tab -> See list of user's offers -> Click edit on an offer -> Update fields -> Click Save -> See updated offer
Navigate to /perfil (unauthenticated) -> See redirect to /auth/login -> Complete login -> Redirect to /perfil

features.name: Gamification (Logros y Leaderboard)
features.description: Sistema de badges, niveles y leaderboard que muestra progreso y ranking entre usuarios activos.
user_flows: Navigate to /logros (authenticated) -> See earned badges and level progress -> Click leaderboard -> See user rankings and stats
Navigate to /logros (unauthenticated) -> See redirect to /auth/login -> After login redirect to /logros
Navigate to /logros -> API failure retrieving gamification profiles -> See fallback message 'No se pueden cargar logros, intenta más tarde'

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Panel de administración para ver estadísticas, moderar contenido, gestionar usuarios y configurar la plataforma.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin (admin authenticated) -> See admin statistics overview -> Click moderation -> Navigate to /admin/moderation -> Review reported content -> Click Hide/Delete -> See confirmation and content status updated
Navigate to /admin (non-admin) -> See access denied message or redirect to / -> See option to request permissions or contact admin
Navigate to /admin -> Admin API returns error -> See error state 'Cannot load admin stats' with retry action

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User registration and login using Supabase Auth

features.name: Deal Management
user_interactions: Fill deal form (title, price, description, link)

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Manage users, reports, moderation, and system settings
